description: This PHP source file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Request, which encapsulates an XML-RPC request, including method name, parameters, XML serialization, and parsing functionality.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Request
classes.description: A class representing an XML-RPC request, capable of constructing requests, parsing XML, handling faults, and generating XML strings for requests.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that optionally sets the method name and parameters for the request.

methods.name: setEncoding
methods.description: Sets the character encoding used in the request and updates related XML-RPC values.

methods.name: getEncoding
methods.description: Retrieves the current encoding used in the request.

methods.name: setMethod
methods.description: Sets the method name to be invoked in the XML-RPC request, returning false and setting a fault if invalid.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the current method name set for the request.

methods.name: addParam
methods.description: Adds a parameter to the request, optionally with a specified type.

methods.name: setParams
methods.description: Sets multiple parameters at once, accepting either an array of value-type pairs or individual arguments.

methods.name: getParams
methods.description: Returns the array of parameters added to the request.

methods.name: getTypes
methods.description: Returns an array of types corresponding to each parameter.

methods.name: loadXml
methods.description: Parses an XML string into the request object, extracting method name and parameters, and handling errors.

methods.name: isFault
methods.description: Indicates whether the current request has a fault set.

methods.name: getFault
methods.description: Retrieves the fault object if a fault occurred during request processing.

methods.name: _getXmlRpcParams
methods.description: Internal method to convert stored parameters into XML-RPC value objects for serialization.

methods.name: saveXml
methods.description: Serializes the request into an XML string that can be sent over XML-RPC.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the XML string representation of the request.
